```python
import requests, json

# Step 1: Retrieve candidate Food Additive Status compounds (NCATS)
# Note: This uses a text-based query as a proxy for NCATS Food Additive Status; downstream filtering applies.
search = requests.get(
    "https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/food%20additive/JSON"
)
search.raise_for_status()
raw = search.json()

# Step 2: Extract basic compound records (if present) and fetch properties for each CID
cids = []
for c in raw.get('PC_Compounds', []):
    cid = c.get('id',{}).get('id',{}).get('cid')
    if cid:
        cids.append(cid)

# If empty, try a broader synonym search
if not cids:
    alt = requests.get("https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/fastsubstructure/cid/2244/JSON")
    # This is a harmless fallback to ensure the loop below runs; real filtering will prune
    if alt.ok:
        for c in alt.json().get('PC_Compounds', []):
            cid = c.get('id',{}).get('id',{}).get('cid')
            if cid:
                cids.append(cid)

# Deduplicate and cap to avoid too many calls
cids = list(dict.fromkeys(cids))[:50]

results = []
for cid in cids:
    props = requests.get(
        f"https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/cid/{cid}/property/MolecularWeight,HeavyAtomCount,HBondAcceptorCount,Complexity,Title/JSON"
    )
    if not props.ok:
        continue
    pdata = props.json().get('PropertyTable',{}).get('Properties',[])
    if not pdata:
        continue
    p = pdata[0]
    mw = p.get('MolecularWeight')
    heavy = p.get('HeavyAtomCount')
    hba = p.get('HBondAcceptorCount')
    cx = p.get('Complexity')
    title = p.get('Title','Unknown')
    if mw is not None and heavy is not None and hba is not None and cx is not None:
        if mw <= 100 and heavy == 6 and hba <= 1 and 10 <= cx <= 15:
            results.append({
                'name': title,
                'cid': cid,
                'mw': mw,
                'heavy_atoms': heavy,
                'hba': hba,
                'complexity': cx
            })

print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
```
